title: As Far as the East Is From the West

request.style: English, Southern gospel trio, a mother and two sons singing close family harmony, gospel piano, acoustic guitar and fiddle, mid-tempo swing, warm and thankful, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lord is merciful and gracious
Slow to anger and abounding in love
He will not always accuse us
Nor keep his anger forever

[Chorus]
As far as the east is from the west
So far he removes our sins from us
As high as the heavens are above the earth
So great is his love

[Verse]
He does not deal with us according to our sins
Nor repay us for our wrongs
As a father has compassion on his children
So the Lord has compassion on those who fear him

[Chorus]
As far as the east is from the west
So far he removes our sins from us
As high as the heavens are above the earth
So great is his love
